Page.Name: page.custom.accordion
Page.Title: Accordion
Page.Subtitle: Raven has no accordion. Its Expander is the native piece: one header, one content. Made exclusive (opening one closes the others, OnChanged="accordion.exclusive" in demos.c), a column of them is an accordion. Below, the same idea in a style of its own: neobrutalism, thick outlines, hard shadows, a yellow highlight.

Label.Text: Orders leave our warehouse within two working days. Tracking comes by email.
30 days, no questions. The label is in the box.
Two years on every part, five on the frame.
<NeoItem> (src/widgets.xml): a black Border behind for the hard shadow, a 3px outline, the header yellow when open.

NeoItem.Title: What is neobrutalism?
NeoItem.Text: Raw, loud interfaces: flat bright colors, thick black outlines, shadows without blur, no gradient. Honest about being made of boxes.

NeoItem.Title: How is the shadow made?
NeoItem.Text: An Overlay: a black Border shifted 6 units right and down (its Slot.Padding), the card over it shifted the other way. No blur, no alpha.

NeoItem.Title: Why yellow?
NeoItem.Text: Because a highlighter is yellow. The header of the open item turns #FFDE1A; the others stay white.

NeoItem.Title: Can several be open?
NeoItem.Text: Not here: opening one closes the others, as in an accordion. Remove the loop in neo_open (demos.c) to allow it.
